{%- doc -%} Existing blog and FAQ destinations shared by desktop, mobile and home. @param {string} location - desktop, mobile or home. @param {link[]} [menu_links] - Existing desktop menu links. @param {block[]} [menu_blocks] - Existing mobile menu blocks. {%- enddoc -%} {%- liquid assign navigation_enabled = settings.ta_vie_navigation_links | default: true, allow_false: true assign home_enabled = settings.ta_vie_home_links | default: true, allow_false: true assign show_links = navigation_enabled if location == 'home' assign show_links = home_enabled endif assign reading_blog = settings.ta_vie_blog if reading_blog != blank and reading_blog.url == blank assign reading_blog = blogs[settings.ta_vie_blog] endif if settings.ta_vie_blog == blank and blogs.news.articles_count > 0 assign reading_blog = blogs.news endif assign faq_page = settings.ta_vie_faq_page if faq_page != blank and faq_page.url == blank assign faq_page = pages[settings.ta_vie_faq_page] endif if settings.ta_vie_faq_page == blank assign faq_page = pages.faq if faq_page.url == blank for candidate in pages limit: 50 if candidate.template_suffix == 'faq' and candidate.url != blank assign faq_page = candidate break endif endfor endif endif capture existing_destinations render 'ta-vie-menu-destinations', links: menu_links for menu_block in menu_blocks if menu_block.type == 'menu' or menu_block.type == 'menu-columns' assign menu_handle = menu_block.settings.mobile_menu_linklist | default: 'main-menu' render 'ta-vie-menu-destinations', links: linklists[menu_handle].links endif endfor endcapture assign destinations = 'blog,faq' | split: ',' -%} {%- capture links_markup -%} {%- if show_links -%} {%- for destination in destinations -%} {%- liquid if destination == 'blog' assign resource = reading_blog assign link_label = settings.ta_vie_blog_label | default: '読みもの' assign resource_type = 'blog_link' else assign resource = faq_page assign link_label = settings.ta_vie_faq_label | default: 'よくあるご質問' assign resource_type = 'page_link' endif assign already_linked = false capture url_token echo '|' | append: resource.url | append: '|' endcapture capture id_token echo '|' | append: resource_type | append: ':' | append: resource.id | append: '|' endcapture if location != 'home' if existing_destinations contains url_token assign already_linked = true elsif resource.id != blank and existing_destinations contains id_token assign already_linked = true endif endif -%} {%- if resource.url != blank and already_linked == false -%} {%- case location -%} {%- when 'desktop' -%}
{{ link_label | escape }}
{%- when 'mobile' -%}
{{ link_label | escape }}
{%- when 'home' -%}
{{ link_label | escape }}
{%- endcase -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endcapture -%} {%- if links_markup != blank -%} {%- if location == 'home' -%}
{{ links_markup }}
{%- else -%} {{- links_markup -}} {%- endif -%} {%- endif -%}
